verdict.rationale: Baseten publishes extensive documented APIs (OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible Model APIs, structured outputs, function calling, streaming, async inference, usage/rate-limit endpoints) plus CLI/SDK tooling (Truss, Performance Client) and explicit coding-agent integration via Switch and MCP servers, giving AI-native users multiple documented ways to drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s) and independent third-party validation of API robustness beyond vendor docs.
